- GET /api/organization/offboarding-export  -> downloads JSON (Content-Disposition attachment, filename surveybeat-organization.json). Admin only. Same pattern as the personal data download: a plain browser navigation/form GET, no fetch needed.
- POST /api/organization/offboarding with JSON payload { confirmation: string } -> empty success. confirmation must equal the Organization's name exactly. 1. Title + body explaining: deleting the Organization removes all its Teams, People, Pulses, Rounds, Submissions, Answers and Results and cannot be undone; the download contains only the Organization's settings, Teams, People, Memberships, Pulses and Questions — NO Results, comments, Actions, Notes, Submissions or Answers (an Organization admin has no access to a Team's Results, ADR 0003).

Clicking it dispatches a message that sets a model flag `offboardingDownloaded = true`. Deletion is NOT offered (the start button/confirmation field hidden or disabled) until that flag is true. On success the session is gone (the server deletes the sign-in account), so follow whatever the self-erasure success path does in App.ts (look at how confirmed self erasure clears browser data and returns to the signed-out screen) and show the signed-out screen. On failure show the failure with problemView.
5. Cancel button closes the confirmation and clears the typed text.
